---
title: "The Evolving Role of Chemometrics in LIBS Imaging: A Scholarly Exploration"
date: 2023-10-04
description: "Discussion of the growing role of chemometrics and multivariate analysis in large LIBS imaging datasets."
categories: [LIBS, Chemometrics, Data Analysis, Elemental Imaging]
---

LIBS imaging increasingly generates very large hyperspectral datasets. This note discussed why **chemometrics and multivariate analysis** are becoming central to extracting robust, interpretable information from those data.

The discussion was linked to the 2023 *Analytical Chemistry* review on LIBS imaging and its future methodological directions.
